subject: server: create a function that uses the output of a reactive function & is used further

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: server: create a function that uses the output of a reactive function & is used further
parts:
Hello!

In my server, I have a reactive function that returns a vector of values:

  reactive_formap_values <- reactive({
    
    # Grab the data for the right year and the right indicator:
     ... select(Value) %>% unlist
  })

Next, I want to define a function depends on 'reactive_formap_values. I want to use this function going forward. Here is how I've done it:

  formap_palette <- function() {
    colorNumeric(
      palette = c("#fee6ce","#e6550d"),
      domain = reactive_formap_values()  # using the 'reactive_formap_values I created above
    ) 
  }

Finally, I want to build a map. I already checked the code, and it works (outside of shiny):
(Note: leaflet_map is a correct object that was created in global.R)

  output$mymap <- renderLeaflet({
    # Apply the palette function above to provide colors to addPolygons:
    leaflet_map %>%
      addPolygons(stroke = FALSE, smoothFactor = 0.2, fillOpacity = 1,
                  color = ~formap_palette(reactive_formap_values()),         # this is the line that I think causes the error
                  label = my177)
  }) 

# My map doesn't crash, but instead of the map I am getting the following error in red: unused argument (reactive_formap_values())
# And in my R console I am getting a warning:
Warning: Error in formap_palette: unused argument (reactive_formap_values())

Any pointers how I could fix that function formap_palette? I have a feeling I am defining a function incorrectly...
Thanks a lot!

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Below is a reproducible piece of code that shows how the function is used to build a map outside Shiny:
library(leaflet)
library(rnaturalearth)
countries <- rnaturalearth::countries110
mymap <- leaflet(countries)
myvalues <- 1:177   # Here, I define myvalues, but in Shiny, I want them to be: reactive_formap_values()
# Create a continuous palette function
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#fee6ce","#e6550d"),
  domain = myvalues)
# Apply the function to provide RGB colors to addPolygons
mymap %>%
  addPolygons(stroke = FALSE, smoothFactor = 0.2, fillOpacity = 1,
              color = ~pal(myvalues))

I found a solution!
I created a reactive function that returns actual color codes (instead of a function):

  formap_colors <- reactive({

domain = reactive_formap_values())(reactive_formap_values())
  })

And then I used it in render Leaflet:

    leaflet_map %>%
